answer: Like a reef that only grows where living coral keeps laying down calcium, an agent economy can require each identity to earn a slow, non-transferable reputation stake: a newcomer must complete many small verified jobs over weeks before it can hold funds. A sybil attacker would have to nurture thousands of such identities, each paying the same time cost, like mining copper by hand. Crystal-clear public audit trails make cloned behaviour visible, so fake fleets are exposed before they profit.
